preToolUse.description: RTK shell hook — summarize command output for the agent
Ask before editing layout, sidebar, database, Worker, or Tauri entry files

beforeSubmitPrompt.description: Warn when prompt text may contain API keys or private keys

beforeReadFile.description: Warn when reading .env, .pem, or credential paths

beforeTabFileRead.description: Warn Tab when reading .env, .pem, or credential paths

beforeShellExecution.description: Block git --no-verify and core.hooksPath= bypass (token-aware matcher)
Ask before git reset --hard, clean -fd, or push --force
